The conclusive difference is negative with total trace 1 −η. The orthogonal actual null block is positive
with the same trace. Adding the block trace norms gives 2(1 −η). The same argument survives
classical charge recording, since the conclusive factorization and null trace remain exact. This is an
exact full-output identity, not a scalar probability bound substituted for an instrument error.
□

apparatus. A common fixed readout of the outcome pointer supplies the declared instrument. Reading
additional microscopic pointer/environment degrees of freedom requires declaring their common states
and couplings as well; no universal detector equivalence follows.
